notes: PowerSchool standards now read on districts that spell their term columns out — "Quarter 1", "Sem 1", "Term 2" — and on the older templates that open with a plus sign rather than an Expand All. When the read still fails, the pane now says which of the seven things went wrong instead of showing nothing. The Classroom sign-in window can be typed into: it takes the keyboard properly, popups work, and it no longer closes itself before you have signed in.
